title: Exact 2-Adic Valuation of Higher-Period Multipliers for a Frozen PCF Quadratic

execution_state_at_lock.prelock_observation: Exact development gcd checks saw no B=+1 or B=-1 hit through period 8; a second timing/resultant benchmark repeated periods 4 through 7. These observations preceded this lock and have no blind or confirmatory status.

parameter.provenance: Inherited unchanged from Batch-01 Paper 2; no multiplier, prime, zero, or spectral selection.

definitions.rational_base2_equality: Lambda_C in Q and abs(Lambda_C)=2^n, equivalently B_C in {+1,-1}
definitions.modulus_only: abs(Lambda_C)=2^n without rationality; outside the arithmetic equality certificate
definitions.characteristic_exponent: chi_C=(1/n)*log(abs(Lambda_C)); chi_C=log(2) is modulus-only unless rationality is separately imposed

frozen_theorem_claims: T1: For a complete non-Archimedean field of characteristic zero and residue characteristic 2, and f(z)=z^2+c with 0<abs(c)<1, every finite exact period n>=2 cycle lies on the unit circle and has multiplier norm abs(2)^n.
T2: For the frozen PCF quadratic, at every cycle-field place w over 2, w(Lambda_C)=n*w(2).
T3: If the frozen multiplier is rational, Lambda_C=2^n*m with m an odd integer.
T4: Frozen cycles are unique Frobenius-Hensel lifts and B_C is the corresponding unramified local norm.
T5: B_C in {+1,-1} forces two specified leading nonprincipal coefficients of the reciprocal residue minimal polynomial to vanish; this excludes exact periods 2 and 3 only.
T6: A rational base-2 equality arising only after repetition already comes from primitive B_C in {+1,-1}.

registered_exact_audit.exact_set_component: Psi_n_set is the monic polynomial rad(F_n)/gcd(rad(F_n), product_{d|n,d<n} rad(F_d)), where F_d=g^d-X; formal dynatomic and scheme multiplicities are recorded separately and never replace this set-theoretic least-period object.

registered_exact_audit.independent_engine: exact target resultant reduced in Q(u), followed by its exact nonzero rational field norm; reduction modulo the fixed control prime q=3 is an optional diagnostic and is never selected post hoc or required when inconclusive
